title: SDLC Acceptance Criterion Reference v1
description: A task-local, task-qualified, or globally qualified reference to an acceptance criterion using the #acceptance-criterion/AC-* convention.
$comment: The host must resolve the referenced acceptance criterion and verify that the reference is within the relationship boundary. Canonical work-item acceptance criteria may retain their WI- or GH-qualified ID after the selector.

oneOf.description: A reference to an acceptance criterion declared in the current task payload.
A reference to an acceptance criterion declared by another task.
A globally qualified repository reference to an acceptance criterion.
